# Outputs Directory

This directory contains all user-facing experiment output files.

## Files Generated by run_main.py

- `experiment_results.txt` — Human-readable results table in plain text format
- `experiment_results.csv` — CSV format results with columns: model, rmse, mae, r2, phys_violation_rate, film_improvement, train_time_sec, eval_time_sec, status
- `diagnostics.txt` — Detailed per-model diagnostic information (shapes, training curves, device info)
- `run_log.txt` — Optional log file (generated when `--log-file` flag is used)

## Note

- Intermediate `.npz` data files are stored in `datasets/processed/`, NOT here
- This directory replaces the old `results/` directory for user-facing output
- JSON and Markdown output formats have been replaced by txt+csv for easier parsing
